method_notes: Ealing community school admission arrangements (summarised in the Starting Primary School 2027 prospectus, 'Community primary school admissions criteria'): children ranked nearest to furthest within each criterion; distance measured in a straight line from the home address to the centre of the school's postcode using Ordnance Survey grid references. Ties for the last place broken by random selection (twins/multiple births all offered). Own-admission-authority schools state their own measuring point in the prospectus: most also use the school postcode centre; Alec Reed Academy measures to the nearest gated student entrance; Brentside, St Anselm's, St Joseph's and St Raphael's to the school's main entrance; Khalsa and St Mary's CofE to the main gate; Christ the Saviour CofE to the middle gate of Christ the Saviour Church porch; Mount Carmel to the front door of the Parish Church of St Peter & Paul; Wood End Primary uses the shortest WALKING route to the nearest gated entrance. Offer tables give the 'straight line distance of last place offered (tie-breaker)' in miles.

gaps: Postcodes, PANs (2027 entry) and school types taken from the Starting Primary School 2027 prospectus (not cross-checked with GIAS); Mount Carmel and Little Ealing both print W5 4EA, and Coston and Edward Betham both print UB6 9JU. The 2024 offers PDF was only obtainable from the Wayback Machine because Ealing reuses the same download id each year. In the 2026 offers PDF the community-school applicant/offer/refused counts are identical to 2025 (apparently copied forward), and Allenby and Perivale show distances with 'N/A' counts; distances agree with the 2027 prospectus table, which was used as the cross-check. Mayfield, North Ealing and St Mark's 2026 show refusals but 'all applicants offered' (refusals presumably applicants placed at a higher preference); recorded as all_offered. St Vincent's 2026: offers PDF says all criterion 8 applicants offered but gives no distance, while the prospectus gives 'Criterion 8 Other Christian, 3.194' - prospectus value used. For Christ the Saviour, Mount Carmel and St Joseph's the last place went to applicants without a supplementary form; distances are measured to a church, not the school. Faith schools' 'all applicants offered' may include applicants whose faith criterion applied. Only distance clauses summarised in the prospectus were checked; full academy policies not read. Junior schools and special/independent schools excluded.
